text: Based on the data from NASA FIRMS, there were no fire detections on asset ASSET-F01 during the period from September 23, 2026, to October 23, 2026. The asset was continuously covered by all sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) throughout this period, and no thermal anomalies or active fires were detected. Therefore, it can be concluded that there was no fire on this asset during the evaluated period.
